messages:
maria: FYI customer acme-42 just escalated — their time-series charts in Console show legend colors that don’t match the plotted lines, tooltips are displaying values from other series, and on iPhone Safari the legend overlaps the chart area (covers the top 30%). They hit it on mobile 3x. Screenshot: https://redwood.host/sup/shot123.png

sam: Thanks — can you paste repro steps and the session info? org id, user email, route, timeframe, and which UI commit/version? HAR if possible.

maria: Repro details: org=acme-42, user=liz@acme.com, route=/dashboard/model-inference, timeframe=Today 09:00-10:30 UTC, console-client=1.12.4 (web build), session=sess-9df3. UserAgent: Mobile Safari iOS 16.6 (iPhone 14). Screenshot + short video: https://redwood.host/sup/shot123.png, https://redwood.host/sup/vid123.mp4

alex: I saw an optimization landed last week that changes canvas scaling for DPR; sounds like a coordinate/scale mismatch between legend draw and tooltip hit-testing. Quick repro I did: open that route, set range 15m, toggle series visibility, then hover — values jump to another series. Probable culprit: coordinate transform uses CSS pixels while legend color mapping uses device pixels.

jordan: I can reproduce on an iPhone 15 simulator (Safari) — tooltip shows "CPU" numbers when hovering over "Memory" line. :eyes:

support-bot: Ticket INC-4321 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P1.

sam: Is this from the 1.12.4 client? Was that rollout gated by a feature flag? If so, can we flip for acme-42 while we investigate?

alex: Yes, the change is behind feature flag chart-draw-opt. I can flip the flag for that tenant and push a fix. Short-term workaround: ask customer to toggle "Use SVG fallback" in Console dev settings (not exposed to end users) or use desktop where DPR scaling is 1. Code skim suggests we need to align canvas drawScale and tooltip coordinate math; quick snippet to try locally: 

```js
// force consistent scale for tooltip math
const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
// and use same scale when mapping mouse coords
const x = (evt.clientX - canvas.getBoundingClientRect().left) * scale;
```

and a tiny CSS tweak that helped in the emulator: 
```css
.redwood-chart-container { transform: translateZ(0); -webkit-transform: translateZ(0); }
```

jordan: Added :thumbsup: I’ll validate after the flag flip.

opsbot: Feature flag chart-draw-opt disabled for org acme-42 at 2025-05-02T13:45:00Z (by alex).

maria: Customer confirmed after the flag flip their charts look correct in mobile Safari. They asked for ETA on a proper patch.

alex: I'll open a fix PR to align drawScale and tooltip mapping, add unit tests for DPR != 1, and aim for a patch release tomorrow. Assigning to frontend squad.

sam: Good. For support notes: workaround=feature flag flip or use desktop; ticket INC-4321 updated. Closing on support side once patch is out.

maria: Closing support thread for now — keep me posted on the PR and release notes. Thanks everyone.
